schema_version.description: This field identifies the data contract version, not a claim of implementation readiness.

id.description: This value uniquely identifies the record within its declared entity and version scope.

source_id.description: This identifier refers to a source in the source registry.

release_id.description: This field identifies the exact acquired dataset release.

source_uri.description: This field records the actual source location without claiming download or permission.

raw_asset_sha256.description: This hash identifies the acquired raw source file.

source_id.description: This identifier refers to a source in the source registry.

source_record_id.description: This identifier locates the actual original record inside the named source release.

rights_approval_id.description: This reference identifies the actual approval for this source use.

uses.description: These operations are the exact uses permitted by the retained license approval.

status.description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

licence_evidence_hash.description: This hash identifies the retained evidence for source permissions.

licence.description: This object preserves the actual source license and permitted uses.

split.description: This field records the fixed data partition for the source record.

group_ids.description: These IDs keep related records together during data-split assignment.

origin.description: This field records actual source origin. It must not promote a substitute to genuine evidence.

text.description: This field contains literal text for the specific typed operation or feedback item.

speaker_id.description: This identifier links an utterance or record to its stated speaker.

l1.description: This field records the declared first language. It does not imply a particular error.

age_group.description: This field retains the source age group without an inferred age.

raw_annotations_asset_id.description: This identifier refers to the unchanged source annotation asset.

normalized_case_version_id.description: This identifier links a source record to its separately reviewed case version.

parser_version.description: This field identifies the exact source import parser.

transform_ids.description: These IDs identify the actual transformations from raw data to this record.

quality_status.description: This field states source-record quality without inventing approval.

source_score_scale.description: This field preserves the original score scale and its definition.
